title: Malaysia to send thousands of migrants back to Myanmar as PM acknowledges junta’s ‘atrocities’
summary_full: Prime minister Anwar Ibrahim’s announcement comes days after the ICJ found Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya minority Malaysia says it will send thousands of migrants and refugees back to Myanmar, despite acknowledging that many asylum seekers in the country had been victims of “atrocities” carried ​out by the junta in Naypyidaw.The announcement comes just days after the UN’s highest court ruled Myanmar had committed genocide against its Rohingya minority.
